description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDevOpsCommandResponse' that implements the 'DevOpsCommandResponse' interface. It provides a base implementation for DevOps command responses, including handling of optional 'serviceName' and 'instance' fields, JSON payload appending, and common object methods (equals, hashCode, toString).

classes.name: AbstractDevOpsCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base implementation for DevOps command responses, encapsulating common response data such as service name and instance, and providing JSON serialization and equality methods.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name associated with this response, if present.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the instance identifier associated with this response, if present.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the service name and instance to the JSON payload if schema version and predicate conditions are met.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on superclass hash and local fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality, including local fields and superclass equality.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Determines if the other object can be considered equal based on class type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation including serviceName, instance, and superclass's string.
